item.title: Free printable: Large-Print 1950s TV Trivia Quiz with Answers
item.description: Round 1 from Nostalgia Trivia for Seniors: ten multiple-choice questions on 1950s television in large print, and the answers, each with a fun fact. Print copies for a group, a game night or a visit. Free printable PDF from the Nostalgia Trivia for Seniors, with the full 174-page paperback on Amazon. trivia for seniors, nostalgia trivia, large print trivia with answers.
